propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhausting its step budget causes the entire bounded recovery to fail instead of preserving partial evidence from other criteria.

LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError raised during per-criterion evidence gathering should be caught and converted to content-free placeholder entries rather than propagating.

The finalizer must receive evidence entries for all criteria, including exhausted ones marked with explicit could-not-gather-within-bounds placeholders, so it can render complete per-criterion verdicts.
Recovery should fail outright only when every criterion's evidence run fails, not when a single criterion exhausts its budget.
Placeholder evidence entries must never be presentable as affirmative evidence and must state that evidence could not be gathered within bounds so the criterion scores as unmet or indeterminate.
